Vendored evaluator-only subset of OMPEval by Timo A. (zekyll), under ISC.
Source: https://github.com/zekyll/OMPEval
Revision: 4aec210ff75b0851af0ee170b35a7899e1a4fe8f

Files are unmodified. Card suit labels differ from this project's labels but the
numeric rank/suit layout is the same. No upstream range parser, equity calculator,
random walk, or libdivide code is included. LICENSE.txt accompanies this subset.
